_readme: Player-facing release notes, newest first, shown by the Change Log button in the lobby. Rules (full text: HOUSE RULES #2 in CLAUDE.md): at most ONE entry per day, id = date. If today's entry exists, rewrite it as one summary of the whole day; do not add a second entry. At most 5 lines per entry. Only list changes players will notice; group small fixes into one 'Small fixes and polish' line. Simple English, no file names, no em dashes.

entries.title: Your turn, with style
changes: When your turn starts, stripes in your colour sweep across the screen with a whoosh and stamp out YOUR TURN.
No more pop-up when you run out of AP. The End Turn button glows green and reads "End Turn to replace AP" instead.

entries.title: Livelier board
changes: Turning the map spins it around the middle. Tiles flip over when turned up or down. Pawns zip across wind stones, sink through catacomb portals, fly off with Take Flight, and glow with magic when taking stones at a shrine.

Every stone has its own drop: earth lands heavily and makes nearby pieces bounce; water, fire and wind drop on lightly, then water bobs like a droplet, fire sparks and wind swells once; void appears with a ghostly glow (stones next to void just drop). Stones burned by fire char away faster.
Bots only feel hurt by something you actually did, and notice (and push back) when you play fast: an early scroll, quick elements.

Casting a scroll now crackles with magic: lines of the scroll's colour join you and the pattern stones, which flare up. Energy swirls around you, a countered scroll shatters, and the counter scroll has its own effect.

Small fixes: undoing a stone break brings back stones it destroyed, replays skip empty waiting steps, Telekinesis no longer leaves a circle behind, the source pool goes up right away when a stone breaks, and Watchable bot training shows all the new effects.

entries.title: Sharper stones
changes: Stone symbols have a dark outline so they are easier to read and should stay sharp after zooming. Earth stones glow a little less.
Shrines on the tiles are now bigger hexagon plates carved into the floor, easy to tell apart from stones.
Inspiring Draught, Scholar's Insight and other scroll pickers show each scroll's full text, with its pattern when you hover it.
Tiles are now thick slabs. Stones crack and shatter when broken. Stones using their ability glow a little brighter, with a tighter ring.

Small fixes and polish: bigger pawns that hop smoothly from hex to hex, pawns no longer slip under stones, no empty response screen in games against bots, clearer picked tile for Shifting Sands and Telekinesis, and Control the Current changes the stone's look again.

entries.title: Player tile rule fix
changes: Pawns are now 3D board game pawns and stones are glass beads lit from inside, matching the board's camera angle. You can switch this off in Settings > Display.
You can walk across another player's tile, but you can no longer end your turn on it. Bots follow the same rule. If you run out of moves there, you can still end your turn.
The rulebook now explains this rule.
Bots handle an element shortage better: they no longer count on Sacrificial Pyre with nothing to sacrifice, and use Heavy Stomp to hide and re-reveal a shrine for a new scroll.
Small fixes and polish: switching from Spanish back to English no longer leaves some lobby buttons in Spanish.

entries.title: Juego en español / Spanish
changes: New: play in Spanish. Pick English or Español on the sign-in screen, or change it any time at the top of Settings.
Spanish covers the game: scrolls, rules, buttons, messages, the game log, the tutorial, the lobby and the shop.
In Spanish, the game music switches to salsa mode: a little faster, with clave, cowbell and conga.

entries.title: Plan games with friends, player bounties
changes: Stream mode is now a Shop feature: unlock it once for 500 gold (Shop > Features, or the lobby Stream button), then your Twitch chat can steer the bots in your games.

New: player bounties. Unlock once for 300 gold (Shop > Features or the waiting room), then put up 100 to 500 gold on your room (others can add more for free): whoever beats you wins it all. If you win, everyone gets their gold back; if a bot wins, it goes into the pot.

New: Plans (lobby button). Invite up to 5 friends, suggest some times, and everyone marks Yes, If need be or No. The host picks the time; add it to your calendar, get a reminder, and join with one click.

Small fixes and polish: no Pause button in games against bots (it is only for games with other people), and the lobby no longer shows old messages like "Adding bots..." or "5 players in lobby" after a game.

entries.title: Stream mode votes
changes: Stream mode votes are more fun: chat picks which player a bot goes after or helps (any player, for 3 rounds by default), makes two bots team up against a player, decides if a bot keeps or betrays its pact, and can veto a bot's cast.

entries.title: Fair play fixes, test games and Stream mode
changes: Thanks to Plunge87 for hosting the stream and to everyone who played and tested! Fixes from that game: scrolls no longer get copied when one goes to the common area, an element no longer counts once its stone source is empty (counters and responses too), and every board now agrees on how many stones are left in each source.

Undo is fixed: it no longer gives AP or stones back after you cast a scroll or teleport, no longer refills spent void AP, and now undoes scroll moves instead of your last step. Sacrificial Pyre can now use a scroll from your active area too, no longer gives free stones, can't use Level I scrolls on your own turn, and costs no AP when it has nothing to use. Also fixed: board stones dropped into your pool, replayed moves after a reconnect, a wrong clock hiding games, black bars when panning.

New: Test games. With another player, let bots play a whole online game for you to help find online bugs; each of you earns 150 gold (up to 2 a day). The screen now stays on during online games, turns no longer jump back after a lag spike, and counters are clearer for everyone (who countered what, Psychic payment waits, refunds on lost ties).

Easier to read: a clearer Opponent Status panel; home shrines show their player's color and won elements (earth, water, fire, wind, void, left to right); click a pawn, shrine or player card to make all three glow; void AP shows as purple pips. Catacomb scrolls show their symbol (plain tan in other players' hands, two colors once played).

New: Stream mode (lobby "Stream" button). Streaming on Twitch? Host a game with bots and your chat votes with !1 !2 !3 on each bot's mood and which scroll it casts. These bots play as Twitchbot on the leaderboard. Also: Breath of Power is now Level II, Respirate is Level III and draws 3 wind, and the pot drop looks better.

entries.title: Bots team up
changes: Pacts now have roles: a scholar hunts for Take Flight or Mason's Savvy, a partner helps build its shape, one bot stands guard with a counter, and others block where the leader can land. Bots also stop a player who is one cast from winning.
Online games pause for everyone when a player's connection drops, and the host can pause at any time. After a minute the host can wait or remove the player. A refresh asks before you leave.

Badges: new pixel-art pictures and 11 new ones to earn (cast every scroll, beat 10 to 100 bots, win 10 games against players, a win in under 10 turns, own every emoji or shop item, send 10 gifts, win the pot). Show them by your name from Profile > Badges; buy more slots in Shop > Features.

New: send a gift from Shop > Features (100g, the player gets 25 to 100g, the rest fills the pot). At the end of a game with 2 or more players, watch the pot drop: every 10g is a gold coin falling through a board of pegs, and one coin that drops down the treasure tube pays the pot to everyone (once a day).
Small fixes and polish: watch for special rewards from The Hermit, bots thank you only for real help, the game uses less power in a background tab, and the Lotus Leaf pawn base is gone from the shop.

entries.title: Clearer bot emotes
changes: Bot emotes: the thinking emote is shorter, emotes clear as soon as a training game ends, and in fast training they show right away instead of late.
New bot emote sentences: pact answers show a crown (against the leader) or a heart (a grudge), and many emotes are simpler and clearer.

Smarter bots: they build on stones already on the board, travel by catacomb and Freedom, stick to their goals, team up against any clear leader, and set up attacks and counters (Iron Stance, Psychic) against a leader about to win.
Game Log has a new Alliances tab: current pacts, how each bot feels about everyone, and what they said this game.
Train Bot: a Speed button to switch between Watchable and Extreme mid-run, and no more menus flashing during training.

entries.title: Bots get unstuck and fight back
changes: Stuck bots now reach for Scholar's Insight, Combust and Take Flight, answer casts with level 1 scrolls, and in 2 player games break your fresh pattern stones and guard shrines you need.

Emotes now stay on the board as you pan and zoom, are outlined in the player's colour, and a bot's new sentence replaces its last one. Bots also show what they are up to (countering, guarding a shrine, running home).

Bots hold grudges and team up against players who hurt them, gang up on a leader sooner, and use more scrolls against a leader: earth walls, taking tiles near them first, moving them away, and counters.
Train Bot: see bot talk at any speed (new Bot talk option), and a list of what the bots said in the training window.

Bots now use scrolls for their abilities (teleports, tile moves, drawing scrolls), break stones blocking shrines they need, no longer freeze when their active area is full, and rarely get stuck standing on a stone.

entries.title: Pixel emotes and credits
changes: New Shop and Credits buttons in the lobby: name styles, pawn items and emojis in one place, and the artists behind the game.
Emojis are now 95 animated pixel emotes (50 gold each, art by Pipoya), saved to your account on any device. The old emojis are gone.
Smarter bots: newest Train Bot brain, water chains, and fewer stuck games (they use level 1 scrolls as responses and break stones blocking shrines they need).

Bots remember who helped or hurt them, gang up earlier on whoever is clearly winning (you included), make pacts they announce with emotes, break your fresh pattern stones, guard shrines you need, and help their partners.

Train Bot: new Formulas option lets bots invent new senses (+10 gold, +20 more if a new one wins), a clearer training window, Save & Quit to finish a run later, and End Early now ends right away when there is nothing new to test.

entries.title: New home, friends and featured replays!
changes: The game has a new home: playgodaigo.com. Sign in there with your usual username and password.
New: Friends! Add friends, see who is online, invite them to your room, and click any name to see a player card. After a game, Play Again Together starts a new room with the same players.
New in the lobby: Watch Featured Replay, a hand-picked great game played at 4x speed.
Bots think much faster, especially late in a game, and keep using scrolls other players could respond to. Games no longer slow down as they go on.

Train Bot: new optional Explore step (+10 gold for a finished run), the challenger is marked with a red X, a more detailed training window, a Leave training area button when a run ends, and runs you stop or end early no longer pay gold. Plus small fixes.

entries.title: Quick Play, pawn decorations, new name styles
changes: New Quick Play button in the lobby: start a game against 2 to 4 bots right away. Bots now clear stones that block their way, pick scrolls they actually need and use Avalanche across the whole board. Fixed a rare freeze after Take Flight.

New pawn decorations in the shop: rims (Gold, Silver, Rune Ring), bases (Lotus Leaf, Stone Plinth) and trails that follow your pawn when it moves (Ink, Embers, Water Drops, Leaves, Void Sparks). Your pawn colour always stays visible.
13 new name styles (elements, metals and animated ones), and name colours now show for everyone: leaderboard, waiting room, player panels, turn display and Game Log.

Fairer wins: the ladder now only moves after a checked, finished game. A win after everyone else quits needs at least 6 turns. Winning as the last player standing now gives your XP (it could get stuck).
When you register you can now add an email for password recovery, and choose to get news emails from the developer (at most once a month). You can change both in Profile > Settings.

entries.title: Replays, password recovery, auto updates
changes: New Replays button in the lobby: watch your finished online games, and post them publicly so everyone can watch.
New Change Log button in the lobby. You can also add a recovery email in Profile > Settings > Account and use "Forgot password?" if you forget your password.
The lobby keeps itself up to date, so the refresh buttons are gone. The leaderboard now shows each player's name colour. A host who closes the page now closes their room right away.
The game now updates itself: when a new version is out, it reloads on its own in the lobby (never during a game).

Fixes: Create and Quick Reflexes now show their activated element to other players (games no longer go out of sync). The "All Slots Full" popup is gone (the Scroll Overflow banner handles it). Small fixes and polish.
